description: Source file implementing the Monitor plugin's JSON-RPC API, including registration of methods, property accessors, and event signaling related to plugin monitoring and statistics.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Class implementing monitoring API endpoints, property accessors, and event signaling for plugin monitoring.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers API methods and properties for the Monitor plugin.

methods.name: endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Sets new restart limits for a plugin based on provided parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_resetstats
methods.description: Resets memory and process statistics for a specified plugin.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves memory and process statistics for a plugin or all watched plugins.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Signals an action taken by the monitor for a specific plugin.
